sources.title: [2405.12843] OpenCarbonEval: A Unified Carbon Emission Estimation ...
sources.snippet: To address this gap, we introduce OpenCarbonEval, a unified framework for integrating large-scale models across diverse modalities to predict carbon emissions, which could provide AI service providers and users with a means to estimate emissions beforehand and help mitigate the environmental pressure associated with these models.

sources.title: Artificial intelligence for carbon emissions using system of systems ...
sources.snippet: The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the environment is the subject of discourse, with arguments for both positive and negative effects. There is a fine line between AI for good and AI for environmental degradation. Today, companies want to seize the benefits of AI, which distinctively involves reducing the company's carbon footprint.
